Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared.
Steps
  1. 1. POST V1 Search (api/FlightSearch/Search) and V2 Search (api/V2/FlightSearch/Search) once per supplier/selector. 2. Record HTTP status, offers count, canBeHeld, haveBundles, offerHasAncillary, offerHasSeat per supplier. 3. For an inactive selector record the error text.
Expected Result
HTTP 200 with non-empty offers[] for each supplier that is active. Suppliers returning the "credentials ... do not exist or are not active" 400 or no offers are listed as BLOCKED for every later row that names them.
Actual Result
SabreNdc/EGY is active on V1 and V2 and returns offers (canBeHeld=4/4 haveBundles=0/4 offerHasAncillary=0/4 offerHasSeat=0/4 | canBeHeld=4/4 haveBundles=0/4 offerHasAncillary=0/4 offerHasSeat=0/4). Other suppliers in the matrix were not exercised (run scoped to SabreNdc/EGY).

Preconditions
TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 passed. Staging only.
Steps
  1. 1. V1: Search -> FareConfirm -> Book. V2: Search -> FareConfirm -> AddPassenger -> Book. 2. Record pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, tickets, ticketingDate and the exact voidCapability value, or "absent". 3. Fill a supplier x version x carrier table.
Expected Result
HTTP 200 and a ticketed booking for every supplier that supports Book. The table is the baseline for the mapping cases. Reference values already seen: SabreNdc/EGY FullVoidOnlyAllowed (since the 2026-10-25 build), TravelportNdc/UAE FullVoidOnlyAllowed (QR and RJ always, EK intermittently absent), GulfAir/KSA FullVoidOnlyAllowed, AirIndia/EGY absent (2026-11-02). Do not fail this case on a missing value; the property rows below do that.
Actual Result
All four cells ticketed (HTTP 200). Baseline table recorded: V1/QR: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed, Retrieve None, tickets 1; V2/QR: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed, Retrieve None, tickets 1; V1/AA: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed, Retrieve None, tickets 1; V2/AA: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed, Retrieve None, tickets 1

  1. 1. POST V1 Void for the supplier's V1 booking. 2. POST V2 Void for the V2 booking. 3. Record HTTP status and body. 4. Label the supplier S (2xx) or U (409 OperationNotSupported) per version.
Expected Result
Every supplier is labelled S or U with evidence; a supplier whose V1 and V2 results disagree is recorded as a defect. Reference: SabreNdc and TravelportNdc (ne-5) are S, AirIndia is U (409 OperationNotSupported). GulfAir, Amadeus, FlyAdeal, EgyptAir, OmanAir, AirCairo are UNKNOWN and decided here.
Actual Result
SabreNdc/EGY is label S (Void supported) on V1 and V2 for QR and AA; V1 and V2 agree
TC-VOIDCAP-POS-01 - [Response] Verify SabreNdc maps a ticketed Book to FullVoidOnlyAllowed and Void then succeeds, on V1 and V2.FAIL
Endpoint Name: Book / Retrieve / Void
Request: Book (QR, plus the AA booking from CAPCHECK-02), Retrieve, Void on V1 and V2
Response: V1 QR: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed, Retrieve None, Void 200 voided; V1 AA: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed, Retrieve None; V2 QR: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed, Retrieve None, Void 200 voided; V2 AA: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed, Retrieve None
Expected: Book voidCapability = FullVoidOnlyAllowed. Retrieve of the ticketed booking carries the same value. Void returns 200 {voided, voidedTickets[]}.
Actual: Mismatch: V1 Retrieve None != Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed; V1 AA Retrieve None != Book; V2 Retrieve None != Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed; V2 AA Retrieve None != Book
Status: FAIL
Evidence
V1 QR: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed, Retrieve None, Void 200 voided | V1 AA: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed, Retrieve None | V2 QR: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed, Retrieve None, Void 200 voided | V2 AA: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed, Retrieve None | Void 200 {voided,voidedTickets[]} on both versions

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book per supplier/version. 2. Inspect the JSON type and the characters of voidCapability (length, leading/trailing whitespace).
Expected Result
JSON type string; length > 0; no surrounding whitespace; no control characters.
Actual Result
Every value is a non-empty string without padding or control characters (the values themselves are judged in VAL-03)
TC-VOIDCAP-VAL-04 - Validate voidCapability is present, never omitted or null, on every successful Book for every supplier.PASS
Endpoint Name: Book
Request: 3 ticketed Books per version per carrier (QR, AA), counted for missing/null voidCapability
Response: 12/12 Book responses carry voidCapability
Expected: Present on 100% of Book responses. A missing value on any supplier, including the intermittent TravelportNdc EK case, is a defect: a client cannot tell "Void not possible" from "capability unknown".
Actual: voidCapability present on 12/12 (100%) Book responses

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book at least 3 times per supplier/version/carrier. 2. Count responses where voidCapability is missing or null.
Expected Result
Present on 100% of Book responses. A missing value on any supplier, including the intermittent TravelportNdc EK case, is a defect: a client cannot tell "Void not possible" from "capability unknown".
Actual Result
voidCapability present on 12/12 (100%) Book responses
TC-VOIDCAP-VAL-05 - [Book]&[Hold]&[BookAfterHold]&[Retrieve] [Response] Validate one definition of voidCapability (name, type, location) across every endpoint that returns a booking.FAIL
Endpoint Name: Book / Hold / PnrReprice / BookAfterHold / Retrieve
Request: Direct Book->Retrieve and Hold->PnrReprice->Retrieve->BookAfterHold->Retrieve per version; name/type/location of voidCapability on each response
Response: 14 responses inspected
Expected: Identical name, string type and root-level position in every response that returns a booking (Book, Hold, PnrReprice, BookAfterHold, Retrieve) on V1 and V2.
Actual: voidCapability is not defined the same way on every endpoint. Missing/odd: V1 PnrReprice, V2 PnrReprice
Status: FAIL
Evidence
V1 Book: "FullVoidOnlyAllowed" (string, root) | V1 Retrieve(ticketed): "None" (string, root) | V1 Hold: "None" (string, root) | V1 Retrieve(held): "None" (string, root) | V1 PnrReprice: ABSENT | V1 BookAfterHold: "None" (string, root) | V1 Retrieve(after BAH): "None" (string, root) | V2 Book: "FullVoidOnlyAllowed" (string, root) | V2 Retrieve(ticketed): "None" (string, root) | V2 Hold: "None" (string, root) | V2 Retrieve(held): "None" (string, root) | V2 PnrReprice: ABSENT | V2 BookAfterHold: "None" (string, root) | V2 Retrieve(after BAH): "None" (string, root)

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Direct Book, then Retrieve. 2. Hold, then FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice), Retrieve, BookAfterHold, Retrieve. 3. For each response record the name, JSON type and parent of voidCapability.
Expected Result
Identical name, string type and root-level position in every response that returns a booking (Book, Hold, PnrReprice, BookAfterHold, Retrieve) on V1 and V2.
Actual Result
voidCapability is not defined the same way on every endpoint. Missing/odd: V1 PnrReprice, V2 PnrReprice
TC-VOIDCAP-VAL-06 - Validate the response carries no duplicate voidCapability key and no supplier-native void attribute beside the unified property.PASS
Endpoint Name: Book / Retrieve
Request: Raw body text of each Book and Retrieve scanned for duplicate keys and other void-related keys
Response: 8 responses scanned
Expected: voidCapability appears once. No extra supplier-native void fields. If one is genuinely needed, it is identical in name and meaning across suppliers.
Actual: voidCapability appears exactly once and there are no other void keys
Status: PASS

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book the same offer on V1 and V2. 2. Compare voidCapability.
Expected Result
Identical values for every supplier. A version-dependent value is a defect.
Actual Result
Differs: AA differs






TC-VOIDCAP-VAL-09 - [Book]&[Retrieve]&[BookAfterHold] [Response] Verify Book, Retrieve and BookAfterHold return the same voidCapability for the same booking state.FAIL

Endpoint Name: Book / Retrieve / BookAfterHold


Request: Book vs Retrieve, and BookAfterHold vs Retrieve, on one ticketed booking per version


Response: V1: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed vs Retrieve None; BookAfterHold None vs Retrieve None; V2: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed vs Retrieve None; BookAfterHold None vs Retrieve None


Expected: Same value in each pair. A flag that appears on Book and disappears on Retrieve is a defect.


Actual: Mismatch: V1 Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed != Retrieve None; V2 Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed != Retrieve None


Status: FAIL

Preconditions

Steps

Mismatch: V1 Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed != Retrieve None; V2 Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed != Retrieve None

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book one ticketed booking per carrier. 2. Compare voidCapability and the Void outcome.
Expected Result
Same unified value and same Void outcome for every carrier on one supplier. A carrier-specific difference (EK absent) is a defect unless the supplier genuinely cannot void that carrier, in which case the value must be VoidNotAllowed.
Actual Result
The mapping depends on the carrier: V1 QR is always FullVoidOnlyAllowed (20 of 20) but V1 AA returned VoidNotAllowed on 4 of 11 Books; V2 AA is always FullVoidOnlyAllowed (8 of 8)

  1. 1. Next day: Retrieve and record voidCapability. 2. POST Void. 3. Record the outcome.

voidCapability = VoidNotAllowed, and Void refused with a mapped business error. The flag is a live, per-booking value (SPEC 4.2/2.15), not a static supplier flag.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book 2 ADT. 2. POST Void with voidTickets naming one ticket. 3. Retrieve.
Expected Result
Either a mapped 4xx rejection with both tickets still active, or a 200 whose voidedTickets lists every ticket actually voided. Never a response that lists only the named ticket while all were voided.
Actual Result
Either a mapped rejection or a 200 listing every ticket actually voided






TC-VOIDCAP-BIZ-06 - [Retrieve]&[Void] [Response] Verify a booking that was voided reports VoidNotAllowed or a terminal state and a second Void is refused.FAIL

Endpoint Name: Retrieve / Void


Request: Retrieve then second Void on a booking voided minutes earlier (V1 and V2)


Response: V1: Retrieve after Void 400 (NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 This Trip Is Already Cancelled), flag (absent); second Void 409; V2: Retrieve after Void 400 (NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 This Trip Is Already Cancelled), flag (absent); second Void 409


Expected: Retrieve returns VoidNotAllowed or a terminal 409 (TravelportNdc returned 409 on Retrieve after Void). Second Void is refused with a mapped error, not 200.


Actual: Not as expected: V1 Retrieve after Void returned 400 (expected VoidNotAllowed or a terminal 409); V2 Retrieve after Void returned 400 (expected VoidNotAllowed or a terminal 409)


Status: FAIL


Evidence
V1: Retrieve after Void 400 (NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 This Trip Is Already Cancelled), flag (absent); second Void 409 | V2: Retrieve after Void 400 (NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 This Trip Is Already Cancelled), flag (absent); second Void 409

Preconditions

Expected Result
Same value regardless of departure date. The void window is anchored on ticketing time, not on departure time.
Actual Result
Same voidCapability regardless of departure date

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Hold. Record voidCapability. 2. POST Void on the held booking. 3. Retrieve. 4. CancelAfterHold.
Expected Result
Void refused with a mapped business error in the standard envelope; Retrieve still shows the hold; CancelAfterHold then succeeds. The error code is identical for every S supplier (record it; do not assume).
Actual Result
Void refused in the standard envelope, hold intact, CancelAfterHold succeeded

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book. 2. Retrieve. 3. Void. 4. Retrieve. Record voidCapability and bookingStatus at every hop.
Expected Result
FullVoidOnlyAllowed before Void; Void 2xx; after Void either VoidNotAllowed or a terminal 409. Same lifecycle on every S supplier.
Actual Result
Not as expected: V1 Retrieve before Void None; V1 Retrieve after Void 400 (expected VoidNotAllowed or terminal 409); V2 Retrieve before Void None; V2 Retrieve after Void 400 (expected VoidNotAllowed or terminal 409)






TC-VOIDCAP-INT-02 - [Hold]&[CancelAfterHold]&[Retrieve] [Response] Verify the voidCapability of a held booking after CancelAfterHold.FAIL

Endpoint Name: Retrieve


Request: Hold -> CancelAfterHold -> Retrieve on V1 and V2


Response: V1: after CancelAfterHold Retrieve 200, voidCapability None; V2: after CancelAfterHold Retrieve 200, voidCapability None, bookingStatus OnHold


Expected: A cancelled hold reports VoidNotAllowed or a terminal error; never FullVoidOnlyAllowed. Same behaviour across suppliers.


Actual: Not as expected: V1 Retrieve 200 shows a live booking with voidCapability None (not VoidNotAllowed, not a terminal error); V2 Retrieve 200 shows OnHold with voidCapability None (not VoidNotAllowed, not a terminal error)


Status: FAIL


Evidence
V1: after CancelAfterHold Retrieve 200, voidCapability None | V2: after CancelAfterHold Retrieve 200, voidCapability None, bookingStatus OnHold

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Hold. 2. CancelAfterHold. 3. Retrieve. Record voidCapability and status.
Expected Result
A cancelled hold reports VoidNotAllowed or a terminal error; never FullVoidOnlyAllowed. Same behaviour across suppliers.
Actual Result
Not as expected: V1 Retrieve 200 shows a live booking with voidCapability None (not VoidNotAllowed, not a terminal error); V2 Retrieve 200 shows OnHold with voidCapability None (not VoidNotAllowed, not a terminal error)






TC-VOIDCAP-INT-03 - [Book]&[Void] [Request] Verify a client that gates Void on the flag has no unexpected failures across suppliers.FAIL

Endpoint Name: Book / Retrieve / Void


Request: Gate Void on the flag across the run: Book flag, Retrieve flag, BookAfterHold flag vs the actual Void outcome


Response: 27 ticketed Books, 20 Voids, 14 ticketed Retrieves, held-Void attempts 2 (all refused: true)


Expected: Zero Void failures after the flag allows it; zero successful Voids on bookings the flag blocked (the second check is run once on one S supplier with VoidNotAllowed from TC-VOIDCAP-NEG-04).


Actual: Gate unreliable: 1 Void(s) failed after the flag allowed it; 14 of 14 Retrieve responses of ticketed, voidable bookings do not report FullVoidOnlyAllowed (a client gating on Retrieve would block a Void that succeeds); 2 BookAfterHold responses on newly ticketed bookings do not report FullVoidOnlyAllowed


Status: FAIL


Evidence
Book flag FullVoidOnlyAllowed on 24/27; Void failed after Book flag allowed: 1; Retrieve(ticketed) not FullVoidOnlyAllowed: 14/14; held Void refused true


View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. For every ticketed booking, apply the gate. 2. Count Void failures after a pass and successes skipped by a block.
Expected Result
Zero Void failures after the flag allows it; zero successful Voids on bookings the flag blocked (the second check is run once on one S supplier with VoidNotAllowed from TC-VOIDCAP-NEG-04).
Actual Result
Gate unreliable: 1 Void(s) failed after the flag allowed it; 14 of 14 Retrieve responses of ticketed, voidable bookings do not report FullVoidOnlyAllowed (a client gating on Retrieve would block a Void that succeeds); 2 BookAfterHold responses on newly ticketed bookings do not report FullVoidOnlyAllowed











🔒Security1 passed3 failed2 blocked






TC-VOIDCAP-SEC-01 - [Book]&[Retrieve]&[Void] [Request] Validate a missing or invalid x-api-key is rejected and no voidCapability is disclosed.FAIL

Endpoint Name: Book / Retrieve / Void


Request: Book, Retrieve, Void with x-api-key omitted and then invalid (V1 and V2)


Response: V1 Book no x-api-key: 401; V1 Book invalid x-api-key: 401; V1 Retrieve no x-api-key: 200; V1 Retrieve invalid x-api-key: 200; V1 Void no x-api-key: 401; V1 Void invalid x-api-key: 401; V2 Book no x-api-key: 401; V2 Book invalid x-api-key: 401; V2 Retrieve no x-api-key: 200; V2 Retrieve invalid x-api-key: 200; V2 Void no x-api-key: 401; V2 Void invalid x-api-key: 401


Expected: 401 or 403 (exact status UNKNOWN, record it); no booking data and no voidCapability in the body; the booking is not voided.


Actual: Problem: V1 Retrieve no x-api-key -> 200 (data in body); V1 Retrieve invalid x-api-key -> 200 (data in body); V2 Retrieve no x-api-key -> 200 (data in body); V2 Retrieve invalid x-api-key -> 200 (data in body)


Status: FAIL


Evidence
V1 Book no x-api-key: 401 | V1 Book invalid x-api-key: 401 | V1 Retrieve no x-api-key: 200 | V1 Retrieve invalid x-api-key: 200 | V1 Void no x-api-key: 401 | V1 Void invalid x-api-key: 401 | V2 Book no x-api-key: 401 | V2 Book invalid x-api-key: 401 | V2 Retrieve no x-api-key: 200 | V2 Retrieve invalid x-api-key: 200 | V2 Void no x-api-key: 401 | V2 Void invalid x-api-key: 401

Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Book on SabreNdc. 2. Retrieve and Void with the other supplier/selector. 3. Retrieve with the original.
Expected Result
Both calls rejected (status UNKNOWN, record it) without disclosing voidCapability or ticket data; original booking still ticketed. Another supplier's credentials never act on the PNR.

Blocked: its core step sends a SabreNdc booking's ids to TravelportNdc/UAE, which is out of scope for this run (the only other SabreNdc selectors, KSA and UAE, are inactive: see NEG-06)

Response: V1: Book body with "voidCapability":"VoidNotAllowed" -> 200, flag FullVoidOnlyAllowed; Void body with the same extra field -> 200 voided; V2: Book body with "voidCapability":"VoidNotAllowed" -> 200, flag FullVoidOnlyAllowed; Void body with the same extra field -> 200 voided


Expected: Responses identical to the calls without the field: the flag is derived by the server, not accepted from the client; the U-supplier Void is still refused.


Actual: The extra field is ignored: flag is still FullVoidOnlyAllowed and Void still works

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging environment selected. Collection variables cleared. TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-03 passed for the supplier under test. A supplier whose selector is inactive or has no inventory is BLOCKED, not failed.
Steps
  1. 1. Search and FareConfirm per supplier. 2. Compare the flag counts to TC-CAPCHECK-VOIDCAP-01 and the earlier baselines.
Expected Result
Same flag values per supplier (SabreNdc all canBeHeld; TravelportNdc canBeHeld all true and haveBundles false; AirIndia haveBundles true and canBeHeld false).
Actual Result
Same flags as the baseline: every offer canBeHeld, no bundles, no ancillary, no seats

Defect — BUG-01 (new)

Retrieve of a ticketed, voidable booking returns voidCapability "None" while Book returned FullVoidOnlyAllowed and Void succeeds (2.9; 2.15; AC Supplier Mapping, TC-VOIDCAP-POS-01)

Field: voidCapability (Retrieve)


Expected value: FullVoidOnlyAllowed (same value as the Book response for the same booking state)


History: First observed in this run (SabreNdc/EGY, ne-3, 2026-11-04). Severity: High.


Impact: A client that reads the flag on an existing booking (Retrieve) concludes Void is not possible and hides or blocks a Void that works; 14 of 14 ticketed Retrieves in this run returned "None". See full bug report.


Evidence: V1 and V2, QR and AA: Book FullVoidOnlyAllowed, Retrieve of the same booking "None", Void 200 voided=true.

Defect — BUG-03 (new)

The unified enumeration is not respected: "None" is returned for held and cancelled bookings instead of VoidNotAllowed (2.14; 6.3 Family F; AC Consistency, TC-VOIDCAP-INT-02)

Field: voidCapability (Hold, held and cancelled Retrieve)


Expected value: VoidNotAllowed for every state where Void is not possible (held, cancelled); only FullVoidOnlyAllowed or VoidNotAllowed may be returned


History: First observed in this run (SabreNdc/EGY, ne-3, 2026-11-04). Severity: High.


Impact: A third, undocumented literal ("None") leaks through the Common Interface, so clients cannot rely on a two-value enumeration and no endpoint ever reports VoidNotAllowed for a held booking. See full bug report.


Evidence: Observed "None" on Hold (V1, V2), held Retrieve, cancelled Retrieve, BookAfterHold and ticketed Retrieve; VoidNotAllowed was seen only on some V1 AA Book responses (BUG-05).

Defect — BUG-05 (new)

V1 Book returns VoidNotAllowed on some AA bookings although Void then works; the mapping differs by version and carrier (2.9; 2.15; 6.2 item d; AC Consistency; AC Supplier Mapping, TC-VOIDCAP-BIZ-01)

Field: voidCapability (Book, V1, AA)


Expected value: The same value (FullVoidOnlyAllowed) for every ticketed Book of the same supplier, and a flag that agrees with the Void outcome


History: First observed in this run (SabreNdc/EGY, ne-3, 2026-11-04). Severity: High.


Impact: 4 of 11 V1 AA Books (fare class B and others) said VoidNotAllowed; Void succeeded (voided=true) on 2 of them. V1 QR (20 of 20), V2 QR and V2 AA (8 of 8) always said FullVoidOnlyAllowed. A client gating on the flag would wrongly refuse to Void. See full bug report.


Evidence: PNRs SJJNJF, ROMSRX, RPUKGE, SGZIEG (V1 AA, flag VoidNotAllowed): Void outcomes 200 voided=false; 200 voided=true; 409 then 200 voided=false; 409 then 200 voided=true.

Defect — BUG-06 (new)

Void on AA bookings sometimes returns HTTP 200 with voided=false and ticketStatus "None", or an intermittent 409 supplier error "Cannot perform cancellation", and the booking state afterwards is inconsistent (2.9; 2.15; 6.2 item d; AC Consistency; AC Supplier Mapping, TC-VOIDCAP-BIZ-01)

Field: Void response (V1, AA)


Expected value: 200 with voided=true, or a mapped error; never a 200 that says the ticket was not voided; Retrieve afterwards consistent with the Void result


History: First observed in this run (SabreNdc/EGY, ne-3, 2026-11-04). Severity: Medium.


Impact: A client reading HTTP 200 as success sees a booking that was not (or only later) voided; PNR RPUKGE showed Retrieve ticketStatus "Booked" while a second Void said "no active order items". See full bug report.


Evidence: SJJNJF and RPUKGE: Void 200 {"voided":false,"voidedTickets":[{"ticketStatus":"None"}]}; SHGVTX, RPUKGE, SGZIEG: first Void 409 External service error (code 325), retry succeeded or reported no active order items.

Defect — BUG-07 (new)

Retrieve of a voided booking returns HTTP 400 "Invalid request" (This Trip Is Already Cancelled), not a terminal 409 or a VoidNotAllowed value (2.11; 2.15 (Void twice); AC Consistency, TC-VOIDCAP-BIZ-06)

Field: Retrieve after Void (HTTP status)


Expected value: HTTP 409 (terminal state) as TravelportNdc returns, or 200 with voidCapability VoidNotAllowed


History: First observed in this run (SabreNdc/EGY, ne-3, 2026-11-04). Severity: Low.


Impact: The same terminal state maps to different statuses per supplier, and 400 suggests a malformed request; second Void correctly returns 409. See full bug report.


Evidence: V1 and V2: Retrieve after Void 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 "This Trip Is Already Cancelled"; second Void 409 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 "The PNR has already been voided".




Defect — BUG-08 (new)

Retrieve ignores a missing or invalid x-api-key and Client-Id and returns the full booking (1.5; 7.14, TC-VOIDCAP-SEC-01)

Field: Retrieve authentication (x-api-key, Client-Id)


Expected value: 401 (as Search, Book and Void return) with no booking data


History: First observed in this run (SabreNdc/EGY, ne-3, 2026-11-04). Severity: Critical.


Impact: Anyone who knows a PNR, gdsPNR and bookingToken can read passenger and price data without credentials. A real ticketed booking was returned with no key on V1 and V2. See full bug report.


Evidence: Book and Void without the headers: 401. Retrieve without x-api-key, with an invalid key, without Client-Id, with an invalid Client-Id (both casings): 200 with booking data (V1 and V2). A Retrieve with dummy ids and no key reached the supplier (409), confirming no gate.

Evidence: Book and Void without the headers: 401. Retrieve without x-api-key, with an invalid key, without Client-Id, with an invalid Client-Id (both casings): 200 with booking data (V1 and V2). A Retrieve with dummy ids and no key reached the supplier (409), confirming no gate.




Defect — BUG-09 (new)

Void on an unknown order returns 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 with the raw supplier request and response in the body (7.14; AC Unsupported Capability, TC-VOIDCAP-SEC-06)

Field: Void error body (OriginalSupplierRequest / OriginalSupplierResponse)


Expected value: Standard envelope only (Status, TransactionId, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage, Context), no supplier payload


History: First observed in this run (SabreNdc/EGY, ne-3, 2026-11-04). Severity: High.


Impact: Supplier payloads (and, per SPEC 7.14, potentially internal identifiers) are exposed to API clients. Seen also on AA Void supplier errors. See full bug report.


Evidence: V1 and V2 Void with an unknown pnr: 409 with OriginalSupplierRequest and OriginalSupplierResponse populated (content redacted in this report).




Defect — BUG-10 (new)

Two error envelope shapes: PascalCase (Status, ErrorCode, ...) and camelCase (status, errorCode, ..., originalSupplierRequest: null) depending on the failing layer (7.14; AC Unsupported Capability, TC-VOIDCAP-SEC-06)

Field: Error envelope key casing


Expected value: One envelope and one key casing for every error


History: First observed in this run (SabreNdc/EGY, ne-3, 2026-11-04). Severity: Low.


Impact: Clients must parse two shapes; validation errors also carry empty originalSupplier* keys. See full bug report.


Evidence: Key sets seen: [Context,ErrorCode,ErrorMessage,Status,TransactionId], [... + OriginalSupplierRequest, OriginalSupplierResponse], and the camelCase set from the AddPassenger/NoSuchSupplier validation errors.
